This line was introduced when the TickCounter class was created from scratch in commit 65a7383f98f831cf957630ed5750bf2ec7f249cf ("Cleans up and simplifies the game's processing in the session."), which refactored GameSession to use this new TickCounter abstraction. Blame confirms the entire file, including the buggy constructor logic, originates solely from this commit.
